stanza: Talula, Talula, I don’t want to lose it
It must be worth losing if it is worth something
Talula, Talula, she’s brand new now to you
(Listen, baby)
Wrapped in your papoose, your little Fig Newton
(Supper's chilling)

filling.line: I know your lungs need filling
stanza: Hey, boy, stop pacing 'round the room
Using other people's faces as a mirror for you
I know your lungs need filling
Since your gums have lost their feeling
But don't say that you're givin' it up again
"Do you have a card?
My irregular heart beat is starting to correct itself"
It's just a simple diarrhetic that prevents the empathetic
From being just and givin' it up (Givin' it up)

killing.line: So you can make a killing
stanza: So you can make a killing
Oh you can make a killing
Oh you can make a killing
A fantastic product—
Killing—

willing.songTitle: I Don’t Want to Change You
stanza: Wherever you are
You know that I adore you
No matter how far
Well, I can go before you
And if ever you need someone
Well, not that you need helping
But if ever you want someone
Know that I am willing
Blessed Savior, make me willing
And walk beside me until I'm with them
Be my mother, my father
My sister, my brother
I am an orphan girl

willing.line: I said I was willing, willing, willing
stanza: I don’t believe I went too far
I said I was willing, willing, willing
She said she knew what my books did not
I thought she knew what’s up
Some say she knowingly tastes like a recipe
Although so foolish and willing
I said, "Babe, I can picture you bend as if wanting to
Bow as the curtain goes down"
